role: The /time command: sets (day=1000, night=13000, or a number) or adds world time on every world server.
scope_reason: Commands never run in this game: the product has no chat text entry (no chat handling in csrc/play/play.c) and no harness path constructs ServerCommandManager (grep of oracle/harness finds none); the behaviors the project needs are the Dev ops of oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Dev.java and csrc/engine/dev.c, not this command system.

members.name: processCommand
members.note: the Dev 'time' op sets or adds st.world_time on every replay world; the day/night word forms are resolved by the Dev op's value instead

members.name: setTime
members.note: dev_apply's time op assigns world_time on each world, mirroring the worldServers loop

members.name: addTime
members.note: dev_apply's time op adds when mode is "add"

notes: Static __OBFID constants are grouped out per the brief.
